div.div: طَلِيَّا , thus correctly, as written by Sgh in the TS, not, as in the copies of the K, طَلْيَا [or طَلْيَآء], (TA,) The mange, or scab. (K, TA.) And A certain purulent pustule, [or eruption,] resembling the قُوبَآء [or ringworm], (K, TA,) that comes forth in a man's side; whereupon one says to him, “ It is only قوبآء, and not طليّا; ” thus making light of it to him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
